risks.note: Inherent geological and exploration uncertainty affects reserve and production estimates; mitigated through geological studies, seismic interpretation, reservoir modelling, technical peer review and phased investment decisions.

Delays in drilling, hydrofracturing, approvals and infrastructure completion (e.g. GGS-1/GGS-2, evacuation pipelines) can defer commercial production; addressed through detailed project planning, experienced project management and milestone review.
Volatility in international crude oil, natural gas and LNG prices affects project economics; management monitors market developments and focuses on operational efficiency for resilience.

Evolving regulatory, environmental and taxation frameworks, and dependence on approvals such as Right of Way / Right of Use, affect project timelines; managed through regular engagement with regulatory authorities.
The Company is exposed to liquidity, credit, interest rate and foreign exchange risk, managed through prudent financial policies and efficient capital structure management.
risks.risk: Financial risk (liquidity, credit, interest rate, forex)

risks.note: Drilling and production operations carry inherent HSE risk; managed through comprehensive HSE systems, preventive maintenance, training and emergency preparedness.

High import dependence exposes India (and by extension the sector) to supply disruptions and foreign exchange volatility, alongside geopolitical uncertainty and cost inflation in steel, drilling services, equipment, logistics and skilled manpower.

Financial performance currently reflects continued investment in long-gestation CBM/exploration projects (North Karanpura, Jharia) with revenue from producing assets still limited relative to the scale of the asset base; profitability depends on timely commissioning of a small number of key assets.
